answer: Sybils are resisted by refundable identity bonds plus rotating peer audits. Each identity locks timber-solid collateral while a random jury from unrelated clusters re-verifies its work each epoch. Like a lantern exposing cloned paperwork, one audit reveals shared funding trails and collapses the farm. Attackers pay N bonds for N fakes; honest agents pay once. From the first dawn, identity carries a price mass minting cannot dodge.
